We have a target molecule: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need a retrosynthesis route up to 5 steps, leaves must be commercially available chemicals, total price <= $9999. Need to propose route and output JSON.

We have one template (38653) that seems to convert a cyclic acetal? The template is a cyclization forming a cyclic ether: [C:1]/[CH]=[CH]/[C:4] >> [C:1]-[C@@H]1-O-[C@H]1-[C:4]. So forward reaction is forming a cyclic ether from a diene? Actually retro: product is diene, reactants are cyclic ether.

Our target contains a cyclic acetal? Let's examine structure: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

Looks like a tetrahydropyran ring (six-membered oxygen heterocycle) with substituents: at C1 (maybe O attached), at C2 etc. There is a side chain with conjugated diene and carboxylic acid (C(O)=O). Also a side chain with allylic alcohol (C=C(CO)/C). So maybe we can disconnect the cyclic ether using that template: break the C-O bond to open to a diene.

The apply_template gave two possible precursors (two possible regioisomers). Let's capture them:

Result: (('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/[C@@H]2O[C@H]2C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C[C@@H]2O[C@H]2/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',))

So two possible precursors: both are similar but differ in side chain arrangement.

Let's denote precursor A: C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/[C@@H]2O[C@H]2C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO

Precursor B: C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C[C@@H]2O[C@H]2/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO

These are likely open-chain diene precursors that can cyclize to give target.

Now we need to further break these precursors into commercially available building blocks.

We can consider disconnections: The precursor contains a diene (C/C(=C/...)). Could be formed via Wittig or cross-coupling. Also contains a lactone? Actually O[C@H]2C(=O)O is a carboxylic acid attached to a tetrahydrofuran? Wait O[C@H]2C(=O)O is a hydroxyacetic acid? Actually O[C@H]2C(=O)O is a glycolic acid moiety attached to O.

Simplify: The precursor includes a 5-membered cyclic ether (maybe tetrahydrofuran) fused? Actually O[C@@H](C[C@@H]2O[C@H]2... ) etc.

Maybe we can break at the C-O bond of the tetrahydrofuran ring using another template.

Let's search for a template that opens a tetrahydrofuran to a diol.
